entry.title: Bill 177 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Passed First Reading → Passed Second Reading
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 26-44, THE OPERATING BUDGET OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2027

Appropriates revenues in the Federal Grants – Byrne State Crisis Intervention Program Grant account ($129,033) and appropriates the same to the Byrne State Crisis Intervention De-escalation Training Program account. Funds will be used to conduct Verbal Judo de-escalation training for law enforcement.

Status: Passed First Reading → Passed Second Reading

Latest action: Council: Bill 177 passes second & final reading - 9/16/2026
